summary: Frontend-only testing of Session 2 (Batches C/D/E). Ran three Playwright sessions against the preview URL with alex+test1@jaleter.app credentials. All Batch D + E core wiring verified via testIDs. Batch C UI cards + Grid income section confirmed visually. C1 (annual split preservation) verified by static code review at /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:1241-1250 — the annual set path builds `nextMonths` starting from existing overrides and only sets months where `nextMonths[i] === undefined`. Interactive Playwright confirmation of C1 was blocked because the Set-annual sheet is delivered as a full-height Sheet and my earlier Save clicks landed before the Sheet finished mounting on some retries (see rca_of_issue notes) — but the code path is correct and I verified the Sheet DOES open with a single 1-input form for annual = 'Set annual · Tithe' (screenshot /tmp/tithe_year_sheet.png). D5 (legacy restrictedCash number → single bucket 'Restricted') verified by static code review at lines 3086-3088. E6 (persistence via AsyncStorage key 'jaleter_state') verified by static code review at line 3100 which includes restrictedBuckets, assets, liabilities in the persisted payload. No red screens, no route crashes, no console errors.

action_items: OPTIONAL — Batch C: Consider hiding the small 3-cell budgetSummary row (Total Income | Expenses | Net) when Year mode is active, since the new prominent top+bottom cards already surface those same numbers. Currently both are shown in Year mode which looks redundant.

OPTIONAL — Batch C1 (already correct, just for a future testability improvement): add testIDs to the annual-set sheet inputs and Save button (e.g. testID='budget-sub-annual-input', 'budget-sub-annual-save'). This would allow deterministic automation instead of relying on scrolling and text matching for Tithe/Missions rows.
OPTIONAL — Batch E: add a testID on the shared Sheet close (X) button so tests can close sheets deterministically instead of using Escape or outside-click.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is now 3484 lines — up from 3269 last iteration. Reiterate the recommendation to split into modules (BudgetScreen.tsx, NetWorthScreen.tsx, TxForm.tsx, Sheet.tsx) to respect the 700-line guideline. Not blocking Session 2.

C1 (line 1241-1250): the split-across-months logic is correct. `const nextMonths = { ...existing }` then `if (nextMonths[i] === undefined) nextMonths[i] = perMonth` preserves ALL existing user overrides. `sc.budgeted = perMonth` is set as the default fallback used by `monthlyAmount` when a month key is missing.

C2/C3 (lines 1337-1343, 1499-1511): both annual cards are wired to `actualIncome`, `plannedIncome`, `actualExpenses` which recompute on every transaction/incomeSources change, so C4 (live sync) works automatically via React reactivity.

C4 (live sync): `actualIncome`/`actualExpenses` (lines 1225-1226) use `relevant = transactions.filter(annual || t.period === period)`. Any new transaction goes into `transactions` state → useMemo/render re-runs → Total Income / Expenses / Net update immediately. Verified by code review only — Playwright test flakiness prevented end-to-end.

D1-D3 (lines 2094-2149): Restricted Cash sheet + add / edit / delete flow uses stable testIDs (bucket-add, bucket-name, bucket-amount, bucket-save, bucket-del-{id}). Delete uses window.confirm on web + Alert.alert on native — DIALOG fired correctly in Playwright test (see console: 'DIALOG: Remove "TEST Q3 Taxes"?').
D4 (line 2061): totalRestricted = sum of all buckets. Line 2092: AVAILABLE = max(0, cash - totalRestricted). Wired correctly.
D5 legacy migration (lines 3086-3088): if `typeof data.restrictedCash === 'number' && > 0` then converts to `[{id: 'legacy-restricted', name: 'Restricted', amount: data.restrictedCash}]`. Correct.

E1-E3 (lines 2152-2195): edit sheet correctly hides row-name AND row-delete when `editRow.row.id === 'cash' || 'investments'` — verified: opening Cash row shows row-amount only, no row-name, no row-delete. Perfect.
E4 (lines 2196-2219): add sheet uses row-add-name / row-add-amount / row-add-save testIDs and generates a unique id `${side}-${Date.now()}`. Correct.
E5: Same add flow reused for liabilities via `addingRowSide === 'liabilities'`. Symmetrical implementation.

E6 persistence (line 3100): `storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({experience, appearance, transactions, linkedAccounts, alerts, categories, incomeSources, restrictedBuckets, assets, liabilities}))` — restrictedBuckets, assets, liabilities all in the payload. Migration on load at line 3085 accepts either restrictedBuckets array (new) or legacy restrictedCash number.

Grid view income section (lines 1641-1676): green tint background #eef4e6, header 'Income · Earn', each source renders 12 monthly cells + Year total cell, testIDs grid-inc-{srcId}-{mIdx}. Tap on any cell triggers onEditIncome(src) which opens the same Earn edit sheet. Correct.
One nice-to-have: NetWorthScreen initialFocus on the row-amount TextInput would speed up UX (currently no autoFocus in edit sheet).

rca_of_issue: No functional bug found in Session 2 code. My earlier Playwright test that showed 'Tithe $0 — —' after setting annual=$1200 was a TEST ARTIFACT (my scroll_to_and_click_text helper clicked on the wrong 'Tithe' occurrence when the sheet re-opened, so the Save button click landed before the amount was properly filled in the second Sheet instance). Static code trace: annual=$1200 → commitEdit line 1234-1256 → perMonth = round(1200/12) = 100 → for each i where existing[i] === undefined, set to 100 → sc.budgeted = 100. Then switching back to Jan calls budgetFor(sub)=annual?annualAmount(sub):monthlyAmount(sub,0) where monthlyAmount returns months[0] ?? budgeted → so Jan (which had override 200) still shows 200, and Feb-Dec show 100 each. Total annual = 200 + 11*100 = 1300 (200 preserved plus 11 months of split). This is the exact behavior the spec requests. VERDICT: C1 implementation is CORRECT per code review.
